properties.name: The content-store retirement now OBSOLETES everything its own text says it removed, not just one capability of five. FOUND WITHIN MINUTES OF SHIPPING THE READER FIX, 2026-08-12, and BY that fix: with `discontinued` finally visible on a read, `cap:content-manifest` came back `realized / discontinued:false` for a tool that no longer exists. `dec:the-content-store-is-discontinued` (accepted 2026-08-09) names its casualties explicitly — "content_put / content_get / content_exists / CONTENT_MANIFEST, content.rs, content_tools.rs, the --content-path flag, and BOTH TEST FILES" — but its OBSOLETES edges reached `cap:content-store` and the five Decisions it supersedes, and nothing else. THE RECORD CONTRADICTED ITSELF: the prose said removed, the structure said live. FOUR NODES WERE STRANDED, AND THE TWO WORST ARE VERIFICATIONS. `ver:content-store` and `ver:content-surface` both read `passing`, last_run_at 2026-07-31, for test files deleted on 2026-08-09 — a PASSING CHECK IS THE STRONGEST CLAIM THIS SYSTEM MAKES, and both were attached to nothing while sitting inside the 138-passing count the graph report shows. `cap:content-manifest` (realized) and `cap:session-artifacts` (VERIFIED, and its whole mechanism was content_put) were the other two. THIS RECORDS AN EXISTING DECISION RATHER THAN MAKING A NEW ONE — Anthony's word 2026-08-12, "go ahead and draw the edges", given after being shown that it moves delivery arithmetic, silences three detectors on those nodes, and changes the confirmed/passing counts. He was asked precisely because this project treats those numbers carefully; the edges make the structure agree with prose he had already accepted. ⭐ THE GENERALISABLE PART, and the reason this is worth reading later: A RETIREMENT IS DRAWN ONE EDGE AT A TIME WHILE THE THING BEING RETIRED IS A CLUSTER — a capability, its siblings, its verifications, its artifacts. Nothing checks that a discontinuation covers everything its own decision text names, and nothing did here. That gap is why four nodes sat wrong for three days with every gate green, and it is a candidate detector: a Decision whose text names removals that carry no OBSOLETES.
